builds.control_boundary: Common cached switch overhead; fresh process per mode.
builds.patch_basis: Independent switch.patch on pinned base; no primary patches.

session.limits: Discrete outer-process samples, not continuous proof. No cross-clock timestamp alignment. Comparisons are conditional on the observed session state, not a lock/unlock causal comparison.

plan.method: Eight serial Williams blocks; one executable, four startup modes and A/A aliases. Original 112-label scale5/min9 suite and 30 retained-11 cases; eight process blocks are the units. No regression exemption.
plan.limits: Shared image holds relative code offsets fixed, not ASLR absolute addresses. All modes pay cached-switch overhead. This is a causal diagnostic, not a comparison against an untouched upstream executable. Host drift and short-case noise remain.

native_execution.method: Preflight and all timing sources/live output on Linux storage. No evidence export or project build during timing. Copy retained files to the local workspace only after timing ends.

limitations: One nominally idle desktop and one shared executable; all modes pay common cached-switch overhead.
Eight paired process blocks; retained in-process repetitions are not independent experiment blocks.
Every slower original-suite median is retained; A/A ratios are controls and are never subtracted.
Same bytes hold relative code offsets fixed; absolute addresses still vary under ASLR. This is not an untouched upstream executable gate.
Synthetic focus/pipeline programs do not establish a real application distribution or whole-runtime speedup.
Value, alias, continuation, trace and selected resource-limit checks are finite evidence; this is not full contextual equivalence.
published_raw_hash_scope: All published files relative to this archive except summary.json
source_hash_scope: Current study source bytes; prelaunch bytes are separately preserved in the capsule
other_digest_scope: Historical pre-redaction build/input provenance unless explicitly scoped
redacted_path_alias_scope: Performance-stage tokens preserve equality of exact full path spellings only
